items.title: Plas Johnson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe and it’s a thrill for me to have Plas Johnson with us today

ctx.x: Millions of television and movie viewers have heard the distinctive sound of Plas Johnson’s tenor sax. When Henry Mancini needed the perfect sound to bring his “Pink Panther” theme alive he knew who to call. Plas has played on countless movie, TV, pop and R & B recordings, as well as being part of the west coast jazz scene. He came from a musical family, and grew up in the birthplace of jazz, New Orleans.
Plas Johnson was interviewed by Monk Rowe at the Sarasota Jazz Festival on April

Today we are filming for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive in Sarasota Florida. My name is Monk Rowe and it’s a thrill for me to have Plas Johnson with us today, saxophonist extrordinaire. I think I can use that word. Have you ever stopped to try to figure out how many recordings you’ve been on?
